workflow.name: Low Attendance Alert Workflow
workflow.description: When student attendance falls below 75%, email parents and notify the counselor on WhatsApp.

config.subject: Attendance Alert: Your child's attendance is below 75%
config.body: Dear Parent, This is to inform you that your child's attendance has fallen below the required 75% threshold. Please ensure regular attendance to avoid academic consequences. Thank you.
